notes.title: Depixtion: Halloween - Standalone Version Retiring From Steam - ON SALE!
notes.notes:
We received a lot of questions and feedback in regards to the announcement of the standalone version of Depixtion: Halloween retiring, so we decided to put together a basic FAQ on how the transition from standalone game to DLC will work:

Q: First off, what exactly is going on?
A: We have decided to retire Depixtion: Halloween as a standalone game, and will be re-releasing it as DLC for the base version of Depixtion. This decision was not made lightly, and was chosen in order make it easier to handle distributing Depixtion and it's expansions across multiple platforms.

Q: What is the last day Depixtion: Halloween will be available for purchase as a standalone game?
A: We will be officially retiring the standalone version of Depixtion: Halloween a week after the Steam Summer Sale on July 13th, 2020

Q: When will the DLC version of Depixtion: Halloween be available?
A: If all goes according to plan, the DLC version of Depixtion: Halloween will be available on October 1st, 2020.

Q: Is there going to be a "Retirement Sale"?
A: Yes! Both Depixtion & Depixtion: Halloween will be on sale for 80% off during the Steam Summer Sale.

Q: Will you continue to update the standalone version of Depixtion: Halloween?
A: Unfortunately, we will no longer be updating the standalone version of Depixtion: Halloween. In order to receive the most up-to-date version, you will need to migrate over to the base version of Depixtion.

Q: What does this mean for those of us who purchased Depixtion: Halloween? Will we have to purchase Depixtion & the Halloween DLC?
A: Nope! We will be giving everyone who has Depixtion: Halloween in their Steam library a free copy of both Depixtion, & the Halloween DLC once we retire the standalone version of Depixtion: Halloween. This will happen automatically, and requires no additional work on your end.

Q: What about my progress/achievements? Will they carry over to the DLC?
A: Yes! We will be migrating all of your current progress & achievements in the standalone version of Depixtion: Halloween over to the DLC release

Q: Does this mean that there will be more DLC releases for Depixtion?
A: Well, we wouldn't be putting all of you through this if we didn't have have plans for more DLC for Depixtion!

We thank you for your patience during this transition, and hope you're all excited!

notes.title: Depixtion v1.3 Release
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

As some of you may have noticed, we have released version 1.3 of Depixtion! This update has been over 2 months in the making, and contains a lot of features and changes that were requested from the community. Here's a rundown of everything that's new and improved!

New Features & Changes

New Controls
The Control Scheme for Depixtion has gotten a major overhaul! There are now 2 available control schemes for each controller type: Default & Legacy. You can switch between the control schemes in the Options menu.

Mouse
Default
Left Click - Colors the Square with the Selected Color
Mouse Wheel - Selects Color (Light or Dark)
Right Click - X/Clear

Legacy
Single Left Click - Light Color
Double Left Click - Dark Color
Right Click - X/Clear

Gamepad
Default
Light & Dark are each assigned their own button

Legacy
Light & Dark are assigned to the same button. You must press the button twice to place a Dark Color

Keyboard
Default
Light & Dark are each assigned their own key

Legacy
Light & Dark are assigned to the same key. You must press the key twice to place a Dark Color

Advanced Tutorial
Stuck scratching your head while trying to solve some of the harder 24x24 puzzles? Then consult our new Advanced Tutorial for some Picross tips and tricks! The Advanced Tutorial can be accessed through the Options menu in both the Main Menu and during gameplay. 

Drag Lock
Drag Lock is finally here! When enabled, your cursor will no long stray into neighboring squares when filling in larger hints. Drag Lock can be Enabled/Disabled in the Options menu.

Drag Lock Counting
Tired of trying to count out 20+ squares in groups of 4? We feel you. That's why we added a Counting system! When utilizing the new "Drag Lock" feature, filling in more than a single square at a time will bring up a counter that shows how many squares you will be filling in

New Achievements
We've added 7 new Achievements to Depixtion! We did this to match the number of Achievements in the upcoming Depixtion: Halloween. Go check them out!

New Music
The great Bonisdead has provided us with 2 new tracks for Depixtion!
There are now 2 alternating tracks for puzzle mode, and a track that plays whenever you've completed a puzzle.

New & Improved Gameplay UI
The Gameplay UI has been completely overhauled. It now sits on the bottom of the screen opposed to the top, and is dependent on what control scheme you are currently using. Whether it be Gamepad, Keyboard, Mouse, Default, or Legacy, your controls will now be visible at all times at the bottom of the screen. 

Undo/Redo 
The Undo/Redo system now tracks on a "Per Move" basis, opposed to being tracked on a "Per Square" basis. For example, if you color in 4 spaces in a single move, it will undo all 4 spaces, instead of the last one colored in. 

First Time Player Popup
New players to Depixtion will be greeted with a pop-up asking if they would like to start with the tutorial. This should make it much easier for new players to get their bearings.

Bug Fixes
  Fixed Timer pop-in
 Removed ability to switch to a completed puzzle
 Fixed Invisible Pause panel issue
 Puzzles no longer save if only filled with X's or Blanks
 Fixed spelling & Grammar Issues
 Fixed issue were hints would not be grayed out on load
 MANY MANY more minor bugs have been squashed 


Thank you all so much for your feedback! We hope you all enjoy version 1.3!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 of Depixtion is now live!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.1 of Depixtion is now live!

We're happy to announce that Version 1.1.1 of Depixtion is now available!  This update includes various fixes to bugs recently brought to our attention by the community.

-=Updates=-

 Fixed Click Drag Bug
 Adjusted Font to be more legible on larger puzzles 
 Added Colored indicators around the panel buttons to better show which layer you have selected
 Various cosmetic fixes


-=Coming Next Update=-

 Steam Achievements!


-=Things After That=-

 Custom Color Palette (Colorblind Friendly!)  
 Controller Re-mapping 
 Column/Row Drag Lock  
 Counting System  
 Advanced Tutorial


We hope you enjoy the fixes included in this update! Steam Achievements are up next, and we hope you're all as excited as we are for them!
